body: The mop and bucket are tied together with torn warning tape. A paper tag with just a number hangs from the knot. I think there's a stamp smudged on the bucket.
title: Mop and bucket

body: A crew carried a tank used on the trial rows, still damp around the valve. I saw a worker rinse his hands in a ditch that flows toward the houses. The grass along that ditch was yellow.
title: Notepad page
